The '''''Lightmaker''''', also known by its [[callsign]] "'''Corvette Five'''," was a [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]].

==Commanders and crew==
[[File:LightmakerScarif.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Lightmaker'' closes onto the ''Persecutor'' during the Battle of Scarif.]]
During the battle of Scarif, the ''Lightmaker''{{'s}} [[cockpit]] was crewed by several [[human]]s<ref name="Rogue One" /> and droids. This included Captain Kado Oquoné, a [[Gender|male]] who served as the vessel's [[commanding officer]]. Before ramming the Star Destroyer ''Persecutor'', the ship was evacuated of several nonessential personnel, leaving a skeleton crew in place to perform the maneuver.<ref name="Rogue One Novel" />

==History==
{{Quote|Call up a Hammerhead corvette. I have an idea.|Admiral Raddus during the Battle of Scarif|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
Before the [[Galactic Civil War]], the ''Lightmaker'' was sent by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] to reinforce [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]]'s [[Phoenix Cell|unit]] of the rebellion along with two other Hammerheads, the ''Amity's Arrow'' and the ''Duchess Senna''. The three ships were stolen by one of Sato's sub-units, the [[Spectres]], during a [[Mission on Lothal|raid]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Princess on Lothal" /> When part of [[Phoenix Cell]], it was one of the few ships to escape the disastrous [[Battle of Atollon]] where one of the other two Hammerheads was destroyed along with many other ships.<ref name="Zero Hour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>

[[File:Lightmaker.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Lightmaker'' intentionally rammed the ''Persecutor'' during the Battle of Scarif.]]
Under the [[captain]]cy of [[Kado Oquoné]], it participated in the [[Battle of Scarif]], the opening battle of the [[The galaxy|Galactic]] Civil War. After being flanked by two [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer]]s (ISDs) and taking heavy damage, the ''Lightmaker'' withdrew from the field of fire to guard the line of retreat. [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] later ordered Oquoné to ram his [[corvette]] into the side of the disabled Star Destroyer ''[[Persecutor]]''. The much smaller vessel's "head" seated itself into a large structural notch of ''Persecutor'' on her starboard side. Captain Oquoné immediately ordered his pilots to activate his ship's sublight thrusters at full power. The sudden acceleration pushed the ''Persecutor'' into the ISD ''[[Intimidator]]'', sending the latter crashing into the [[Shield Gate]] protecting [[Scarif]], disabling the [[planet]]ary [[force field]], thus allowing [[Death Star plans|crucial transmissions]] from Scarif to finally reach the rebel [[fleet]]. Though the plan was successful, ''Lightmaker'' was destroyed in combat.<ref name="Rogue One Novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lightmaker'' first appeared as one of the three ''Sphyrna''-class corvettes given by Bail Organa to the Lothal rebels in "[[A Princess on Lothal]]," the mid-season premiere of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' TV series, which aired on [[Disney XD]] [[January 20]], [[2016]].<ref name="Leia Scoop">{{WebCite|url=https://www.tvinsider.com/64379/star-wars-rebels-scoop-princess-leia-set-to-appear-on-the-disney-xd-animated-series|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Scoop: Princess Leia Set to Appear on the Disney XD Animated Series|author=Sands, Rich|date=2016-01-11|work=TV Insider|archivedate=20180831104309}}</ref> The corresponding episode guide on [[StarWars.com]] identifies the three Hammerhead corvettes as [[P1]], [[P2]], and [[P3]].<ref name="APOL Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-princess-on-lothal-episode-guide|text="A Princess on Lothal" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref>

The corvette was later identified as the ''Lightmaker'' in the [[2016]] [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|novelization]] of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One Novel" />

[[File:Hammerhead_corvette.png|thumb|right|240px|P1]]
Although ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' states that the three ships given to the Lothal rebels were named ''Lightmaker'', ''Duchess Senna'', and ''Amity's Arrow'',<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> and ''Rogue One''{{'s}} ''Lightmaker'' appears very similar to ''Star Wars Rebels''{{'}} P1, with a notable difference being the lack of the [[Aurebesh]] characters "P1" on the ''Rogue One'' model,<ref name="Rogue One" /><ref name="Princess on Lothal" /><ref name="APOL Episode Guide" /> no official source to date clarifies the three ''Rebel Files'' ships' correspondance to P1, P2, and P3.

''Rogue One''{{'s}} visual effects supervisor, [[John Knoll]], mentioned that there was much back-and-forth about whether the crew survived; cutting to shots of [[escape pod]]s were deemed distracting by [[Gareth Edwards]], so [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] merely implied they survived by not having the pods present during the collision of the disabled Star Destroyer with the Shield Gate. Knoll speculated that, given the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] fires on the position where the pods would land, it was still unlikely any of the ''Lightmaker''{{'s}} crew survived.<ref name="Entertainment Weekly" /> The novelization of the film clarified that the ship was evacuated of nonessential personnel before performing the maneuver as well as including a scene where Raddus notices several escape pods floating by afterwards, mentioning that Raddus did not dare hope of them originating from the ''Lightmaker''.<ref name="Rogue One Novel" />
